title: neocallitropsis
intro: Neocallitropsis, commonly known as the Pandanus pine or Pandanus tree, is a species of palm tree that belongs to the family Pandanaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Neocallitropsis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage.
